name: routing_v2
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer writing about? Pick the closest option.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase or charge on the account the customer did not make or does not recognise ('unknown charge', 'payment I didn't make'), even if they ask for a refund or dispute
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: An unknown or unrecognised direct debit
criteria.compromised_card: Card may be compromised, someone else used it, suspicious activity, wants to freeze the card or account because of unauthorised use
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen, report a stolen card, found a lost card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen, can't find phone with the app on it
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM kept, took or swallowed the card
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked or locked after wrong attempts, PIN no longer works to access the card
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot or cannot enter the app passcode, locked out of the app, passcode error
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase from a merchant, changed mind, goods not arrived, how to get a refund
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not appeared on the account/statement
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate charge for one purchase
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave less cash than requested, or cash not received from the ATM
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted, returned or cancelled and money came back / payment was cancelled
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A single small unexplained extra charge or fee seen on the statement or app (e.g. an extra £1 charge), not linked to any purchase, withdrawal, transfer, top-up or travel
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase, charged more than expected for a purchase abroad
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Exchange rate or fee for withdrawing cash abroad/in a foreign currency, wrong rate on an ATM withdrawal, weekend rates for getting cash
criteria.exchange_charge_complaint: Complaint that a currency exchange cost too much or the exchange charge is not right
criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a new card
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet, tracking the card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery to a date or country, express delivery
criteria.card_linking: Link or add a card to the app, make a card show up in the app, re-add a found card
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring, renew or replace an expiring card
criteria.order_physical_card: Order a physical card, new or replacement card, card fees
criteria.getting_spare_card: Get an additional or second card, extra cards
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Get or access a virtual card
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: Disposable virtual cards: getting one, how many, limits on use
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual or disposable card rejected or not working
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Visa or Mastercard choice, which card brand you get
criteria.supported_cards: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) are accepted or supported
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, which shops/ATMs can be used
criteria.card_not_working: Card stopped working, card declined for purchases, card payment rejected
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM withdrawal declined, ATM did not let me get cash
criteria.change_pin: Change PIN, where to change the PIN, PIN questions
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs support the card, ATM questions
criteria.pending_card_payment: Card payment still pending, hasn't gone through
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal still pending, ATM withdrawal not cleared
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up via Apple Pay / Google Pay
criteria.top_up_failed: Top-up failed or did not work, card declined when topping up
criteria.pending_top_up: Top-up pending, top-up money not yet showing
criteria.top_up_reverted: Top-up reverted or money from top-up vanished
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up with a card, top up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Top up with cash or cheque, deposits, where to top up with cash
criteria.top_up_general: General top-up questions: how to top up, which methods/apps
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer in
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_deposit: Balance not updated after a cheque or cash deposit
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account from another bank or card
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money, getting paid into the account, salary
criteria.transfer_timing: How long a transfer takes, transfer from abroad timing, SWIFT
criteria.pending_transfer: Transfer pending or still waiting to arrive
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Recipient has not received the transfer, payment can't be found on receiving side
criteria.failed_transfer: Transfer failed, why transfers fail, sent to the wrong account and needs fixing
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a card payment or purchase, including unexpected extra fees on purchases made abroad or while travelling
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charged a fee for an ATM cash withdrawal, is there a fee for withdrawals
criteria.top_up_fee: Fee for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: How exchange rates are set, what rate is used
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.exchange_charge: General question about fees for currency exchange
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, documents needed
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification not working, app doesn't recognise me
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or details are needed
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Source of funds / source of money verification
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code, why a top-up must be verified
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer or beneficiary is not allowed, not possible or blocked; customer told they cannot make a transfer to someone
criteria.age_limit: Age requirements to open an account
